Not saved: the sample opened as your own copy, as Figma opens a Community file as a copy. It is not kept until you make something in it (a run, a style, a set or a note). Existing mark, glossary.md 10; the sample rule is proposed in framework-changes.md. Mantine Badge.
The drop target names no file: a browser does not reveal a dragged file's name until the drop. Figma: a drop lands content where it falls; here a choice step follows, because one file can mean several things on a loaded graph (interaction-pattern-entries.md 4.5). Mantine Dropzone (not yet in compact-mantine).
The dragged file's picture and name are drawn by the operating system, not by graphty.
Colors and sizes come from the sample's own style layers, Size: degree and Group color, listed under Styles and in the legend. Figma: the canvas carries no chrome but the toolbar and Help; here one legend (figma-crosswalk.md 4.1, 'The canvas carries no chrome'). Legend drawn by graphty-element.
Keyboard focus: the canvas, where the sample opened. A drag moves no focus.
Screen reader hears: on open, "Les Miserables sample opened as a copy: 77 nodes, 254 edges. Not saved." During the drag, nothing: a drag is pointer-only, and File, Open... and paste are the keyboard routes.

A graph file: JSON with nodes and links. What should happen to it?
Open as a new project
Only this file, in its own project. The sample copy stays as it is.

While the open project is an unkept sample copy, the step leads with the two choices a first visit needs; the other three sit behind More ways. Each row commits its own result; there is no Continue. Proposed in framework-changes.md. compact-mantine ActionRows in a Mantine Modal with ModalFooter. Figma: a drop lands content; here a choice step (interaction-pattern-entries.md 4.5).
Keyboard focus: Open as a new project when the step opens; she pressed Down once, so it is on Update with new data. Enter or a click commits the row.
Screen reader hears: "miserables.json, dialog. A graph file: JSON with nodes and links. What should happen to it? Open as a new project, 1 of 3." On Down: "Update with new data. Your file's nodes and edges, drawn with this sample's colors and sizes, 2 of 3."

A note about a node starts with no citation; Cite a run... and Quote a value... add them. framework-changes.md, "Take a note". compact-mantine PopoutPanel; a Textarea while writing.
The inspector's Notes section lists the note once it exists (two lines at most). Figma: no inspector lists commentary; here a Notes section, present once a note targets the object (figma-crosswalk.md 4.3). compact-mantine Tree row.
The Note tool on the toolbar (key C, proposed) is the visible route; Add note in the node's menu is the other. The tool stays armed until Esc, and its click does not change the selection (interaction-pattern-entries.md 5; framework-changes.md). compact-mantine ToolButton.
